text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s25","problem":"Body text is clipped at the right edge on all four screens (\"Toto,\", \"a more\", \"bloody nose.\", \"after\" cut off). The mock's text column is wider than the real one, so lines wrap differently. This shows as red streaks across every paragraph.","fix":"Set the paragraph container to left 20px, right 20px (width about 371px) with overflow hidden, and use the same font size and line-height as the real screen (about 24px). Words such as \"more\", \"nose.\" and \"after\" must wrap onto the next line as they do in the real app."},{"element_id":"s26","problem":"The footer line \"Kristi Noem Files for Divorce From Bryon Noem After Photo\" is cut off as \"Phot\" and runs into the arrow. On the real screen the text wraps, so \"Scandal\" sits on line 2 with the arrow in its own column.","fix":"Give the footer text block a right edge of about 350px, leaving 40px for the arrow. Text is 13px with line-height 24px, and \"After Photo\" ends line 1. The arrow icon (assets/s26.e21.png) stays at x363, y772, 24x24. Apply the same change on s25, s27 and s28."},{"element_id":"s25","problem":"The article photo is a flat stand-in illustration (blond cartoon face) instead of the real photo of Amber Glenn, which produces heavy red across the whole image area.","fix":"If a listed picture for this photo exists, draw it at its rect; none is listed. Otherwise change the stand-in to a closer color match: a dark brown-orange blurred background (#5a3a22), a green plant at the left, a gray shirt (#8a8a8a) and a lighter skin tone. Keep the box at x20, w371 and the same y as the real one."},{"element_id":"s25","problem":"The ad image is a cartoon stand-in (a striped roof with a dark figure) rather than the real photo of a worker on a roof with a ladder. The \"Test Ad\" label and the blue ad triangle are also slightly off.","fix":"Restyle the ad image box (x56, y37, w300, h174, radius 10px) with a gray-green roof and a yellow ladder at upper left. Set \"Test Ad\" at 14px on a dark translucent pill, and move the ADVERTISEMENT header down 2px to y≈19."},{"element_id":"s26","problem":"The caption \"Amber Glenn on ‘Dancing With the Stars’Credit: abc\" and the ad headline sit about 1-2px higher than in the real screen.","fix":"Shift the ad headline and the \"Homebuddy.com\" row down 1-2px so their tops match the real screen (headline at y≈97-105). Keep the caption color at #777."}],"summary":"All tagged elements are within 4px and there are no failed taps or contract errors, so the remaining loss comes from visuals. The biggest issue is that body text and the footer are too wide and clip at the right edge, which changes the line wraps. This round should fix the text column widths, the footer wrapping, and the photo and ad stand-ins' colors."}
